user_goal: Wide-net astrology-event correlation study: test all data domains (finance, natural, macro, human behavior, space weather) against 910 astrological features with mandatory placebo gate and falsification battery. Document every result. Find any real connection or definitively show none exists.

repo.stack: Python, swisseph, pandas, sklearn, yfinance, requests

assumptions.assumption: v4 generate_features.py is importable from astrology_mapping_v5 via sys.path
assumptions.risk_if_wrong: Need to copy or package the engine

assumptions.assumption: yfinance, FRED direct CSV, USGS API, GFZ Potsdam, SIDC, HURDAT2 are all accessible without auth
assumptions.risk_if_wrong: Some domains may be skipped; target >=12 of 20

assumptions.assumption: Calendar placebo will match or beat astro on S&P 500 (confirmed by v4 placebo test)
Git branch astro-mapping-v5 isolates all new work from main
assumptions.risk_if_wrong: Low — branch is live and confirmed

work_items.description: Build shared infrastructure: data fetcher, domain runner, master runner
work_items.why: Reusable pipeline prevents duplication across 20 domains
work_items.ruled_out: One-off scripts per domain — too slow and unmaintainable

work_items.description: Test all 20 data domains with placebo gate + falsification battery
work_items.why: Core research goal — cast the widest possible net
work_items.ruled_out: Finance-only — prior study showed that approach produces era-confounded results
work_items.verification: synthesis_report.md has results table with >= 12 domains

work_items.description: Deep-dive on any candidate signal that passes all gates
work_items.why: Must try to disprove before accepting any connection
work_items.ruled_out: n/a — only triggered if something actually passes
work_items.verification: deepdive.md exists for each passing domain

work_items.description: synthesis_report.md with cross-domain comparison and final conclusion
work_items.why: User needs the big picture, not just per-domain files
work_items.verification: synthesis_report.md exists with summary table and conclusion

changed_files.what_and_why: All v5 code lives here on astro-mapping-v5 branch

bugs_found.bug: v4 pipeline epoch confound — slow outer-planet features proxy target autocorrelation
bugs_found.status: fixed in v5 via detrended targets + placebo gate + fast-feature split
bugs_found.evidence: calendar AUC 0.6745 beat astro AUC 0.6626 on high_vol_day

risks.risk: Even with methodology fixes, 20 domains with 910 features each may produce no genuine signal — the result 'astrology correlates with nothing' is valid science but may take days of compute
risks.why_it_matters: User wants a real answer, not a premature null result
risks.evidence: v4 placebo confirmed null result for S&P 500
risks.next_step: If all 20 domains null, this is the definitive answer and should be reported clearly

risks.risk: Some natural/human data sources (NHTSA, CDC FluView) may have API changes or broken endpoints
risks.evidence: Known API instability for NHTSA FARS
risks.next_step: Teamwork agent will skip and document; fallback to local CSV if available
